_meta.note: Reference primers (concept material). Copy to data/references.json (gitignored, local-only) and fill with your own. When a technical question has no exact answer key but a reference's 'match' keywords appear in the question, the grader grounds 'correctness' in that reference's content. Good for concept-heavy topics (EV vs equity value, LBO, DCF) where there's no per-question key.

schema.topic: string — shown to the grader (e.g. 'Equity & Enterprise Value')
match: string keywords — if any appears in a question, this reference is used

references.content: Equity Value = value to common shareholders. Enterprise Value = value to ALL investors (debt + equity + preferred + NCI) for the core operating business; EV = Equity Value + Debt + Preferred + NCI − Cash & non-core assets. Financing events (raising debt, issuing dividends, share issuance to hold as cash) don't change EV because they only move non-core items. EV/EBITDA, EV/EBIT, EV/Revenue pair with EV (capital-structure-neutral); P/E pairs with Equity Value. (Replace this with your own primer text.)
